name: Third-Friday a.m. settlement spike and opex-week amplification (replacing pinning)
source_url: https://www.aeaweb.org/conference/2025/program/paper/N7rsBN2N (Terstegge & Whelan, AEA 2025 program entry); Elms (2026) SSRN 6564078 via secondary summary https://harbourfrontquant.substack.com/p/from-pinning-to-amplification-evidence (full SSRN text not retrieved)
author_year: Terstegge & Whelan (2025, AEA conference paper) [uncertain for author list]; Elms (2026, SSRN)
instrument: ES (S&P 500 E-mini) futures per Terstegge & Whelan; SPY per Elms. Maven MT5 mapping: US500 or US100 CFD, tracking not verified [uncertain]
timeframe: Intraday, likely 1-minute or trade-level (E-mini trades); exact resolution not extracted [uncertain]
entry_rule: Terstegge & Whelan: a price spike in ES appears within the a.m. settlement window on third-Friday expirations; trading direction and entry timing not extracted [uncertain]. Earlier draft frames the spike as overnight E-mini trading before third Fridays [uncertain]
exit_rule: Not extracted. Likely at the end of the a.m. settlement window, not verified [uncertain]
holding_time: Minutes to about one hour; not extracted [uncertain]
trades_per_year: About 12 per year if traded on every monthly third Friday (4 quarterly triple-witching dates among them); derived, not sourced [uncertain]
overnight_weekend: Earlier draft places the spike in overnight trading before third Fridays, so an overnight holding component is possible [uncertain]. Final paper's overnight treatment not extracted
signal_window_definition: A.m. settlement window of the expiring SPX contracts, defined by the exchange opening print on expiration Friday (general knowledge, not verified in this session) [uncertain]. DST: US Eastern time handling not extracted [uncertain]
sample_period: Not extracted from the readable sources [uncertain]. Elms: 2016 to 2025, 2,294 trading days
out_of_sample: Not reported in readable sources. Elms's regime-shift finding is a hypothesis for further study, not a tested out-of-sample rule [uncertain]
reported_metrics: Terstegge & Whelan: spike confined to a.m. settlement window (figure caption); magnitude in ES points not extracted [uncertain]. Elms: high near-expiry ATM open interest linked to wider daily ranges (p < 0.001); about 16% wider ranges (blog author's figure, method unclear) [uncertain]
third_party_replication: Partial and conflicting. Golez & Jackwerth (JFE 2012) document pinning in S&P 500 futures on serial option expiration days; Elms (2026) finds no pinning over 2016 to 2025 and frames it as amplification. Independent test of the third-Friday spike not found
evidence_grade: Conference paper (AEA 2025; not confirmed as peer-reviewed) and SSRN working paper (Elms; full text not verified). Secondary blog summary only for Elms
decay_status: Elms: pinning (documented through 2009) has given way to amplification in 2016 to 2025; third-Friday-specific decay not tested [uncertain]
regime_split: Elms: regime shift from pinning (earlier period) to amplification (2016 to 2025). Terstegge & Whelan: spike identified over a sample not extracted [uncertain]
data_source_requirement: ES or SPY trade-level or 1-minute data, plus expiration calendar. Option open interest and charm data are not in Maven MT5 and would be required to test the mechanism; a price-only test is possible [uncertain]
min_lot_fit_5k10k: Stop not defined. Illustration: on US500 CFD the risk per 0.01 lot depends on contract size, which must be confirmed on Maven [uncertain]
fn_rule_fit: The a.m. settlement is not a news event, but the 08:30 ET releases can fall on or near third-Friday mornings; +/-5 minute news rule to be checked. FundedNext rule text not verified in this session [uncertain]
bot_policy_compliance: Calendar-triggered rule, implementable as an EA with no messaging link. FundedNext bot policy not verified in this session [uncertain]
event_overlap: A.m. settlement window at US open (09:30 ET), quarterly triple-witching dates, and possible scheduled macro releases at 08:30 ET on the same morning [uncertain]
overlap_with_existing: Moderate with US100 Sweep (both trade US index opening behaviour). Estimated qualitatively [uncertain]
rejected_catalog_hit: Not checked. Run: python -m intraday.elenenler --kontrol opex (in the main session) [uncertain]
base_rate_check: Not computed. Opening-range volatility on expiration Fridays is likely higher than an ordinary Friday, so the claim must be compared against same-time, non-expiry baseline ranges [uncertain]
pitfall_risk: High. (1) Very small n: about 12 events per year, so a 10-year test has about 120 observations, and quarterly events fewer; (2) window and direction chosen after viewing the spike figure (post-hoc risk); (3) pinning and amplification findings conflict, so the effect sign is uncertain; (4) SPY vs ES and CFD tracking mismatch
